text.description_html:
Screw Covers for the THI-1183 Series Surface Mount Continuous Hinge

Designed to fit the THI-1183 Surface Mounted Continuous Hinge, the THI-1183COV screw cover comes packaged with 2 covers: the first is is 25/32" wide and the second is 5/52" wide. Both run along the length of the entire hinge to hide all the unsightly screws. Choose from Aluminum or Dark Bronze.

Features and Specifications of the THI-1183COV Screw Cover:

  • Left Screw Cover: 25/32" Wide x 83" Long
  • Right Screw Cover: 5/52" Wide x 83" Long

Includes Two (2) Screw Covers
